_comment: Everything project-specific lives here. The engine knows nothing else.
streams  — one per person who owns a slice of the work. The key becomes
the first character of that stream's task IDs (A-001, B-014),
and its colour on the chart. Eight maximum: past that no two
task_id  — the regex your task IDs match. Whatever you choose, it must be
greppable in a commit subject, because that is how status is
derived. Keep it short and unambiguous.
backlogs — globs for the markdown files holding the tasks. Give each
stream its own `backlog` instead if you prefer one file each.
branch   — the integration branch. Merged there means done.
repo     — owner/name on GitHub. Leave empty to skip PR status and briefs.
